records.name: Athlete
records.why: DAS · Core has an entry under this identifier

records.name: Akmon, Hammer of Purphoros
records.why: Data lacks fire resistance and exhaustion immunity while held, smith advantage, once-per-dusk spell limits and piety-based benefits.

records.name: Dekella, Bident of Thassa
records.why: Dominate limited to swimming beasts/monstrosities, weather command and piety-gated benefits are not carried; extra cold damage and uses exist.

records.name: Ephixis, Bow of Nylea
records.why: Data lacks 19-20 crit range, no long-range disadvantage, extra damage, and per-arrow season effects; no effects in structure.

records.name: Khrusor, Spear of Heliod
records.why: Reaction counterattack after taking damage, blind until next turn, once per dawn, plus extra radiant damage not on the attack; data lacks it.

records.name: Mastix, Whip of Erebos
records.why: Life drain equal to half necrotic dealt, once-per-dusk 300 ft range boost and spell limits (undead only) need rules beyond data.

records.name: Potion of Aqueous Form
records.why: Data lacks the transformation effects: resistance to nonmagical damage, save advantage, no attacking or casting, ends when incapacitated.

records.name: Siren Song Lyre
records.why: Four cast activities with per-spell uses already match the text; DC 13 and dawn recharge per spell are close enough.

records.name: Sling Bullets of Althemone
records.why: Bullet bonus, teleport back on a miss and losing magic after a hit are not in data; only a placeholder utility exists.

records.name: Two-Birds Sling
records.why: Ricochet to a second target within 10 feet with a follow-up attack; data lacks it.
